title: Catch interactive paranormal theatre at Last Picture House

content:
Paranormal investigator Aaron G. Thompson from Netflix's 28 Days Haunted, has a brand-new live paranormal experience for the Quad Cities, just in time for Halloween.

THE BEST DAMN GHOST TALK... OF YOUR LIFE! is a 90-minute interactive paranormal theater show at The Last Picture House, 325 E. 2nd Street in Davenport, on Friday, October 30 at 7 p.m.

Thompson, who co-presents the show with his wife and fellow researcher Kathryn "Kat" Thompson, has spent over 20 years investigating the paranormal. The Ghost Talk turns the investigations into a single live night featuring real investigations, real data and a show the audience helps steer in real time.

"This isn't a haunted house and it isn't a lecture," Thompson said. "It's a live ghost hunt with a room full of people. The audience helps decide where the night goes. Every show is different because every crowd is different. And you get to do it sitting down, with a cocktail, in a beautiful old cinema ."

The show is set up as a grown-up Halloween weekend night out: one seating, limited seats, no lines, no waiting. Tickets are $13, plus a $1.99 booking fee, and available now at the Last Picture House's website.

Aaron G. Thompson is a Davenport-based paranormal investigator and researcher based in Davenport and active since 1999. He is a featured talent on Netflix's 28 Days Haunted. Kathryn "Kat" Thompson is a paranormal researcher who investigates with Aaron as his wife and research partner.
